## Summary

Describe the engineering/software change and why it is needed.

## Validation

Describe tests, benchmarks, models, screenshots generated by AsterMax, or other evidence used to validate the change.

## Provenance / IP checklist

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution.
- [ ] I have not copied proprietary source code, decompiled/disassembled implementation code, confidential material, or restricted assets.
- [ ] If this feature was informed by Google, YouTube, forums, blogs, documentation, another application, or other public references, I used those sources as knowledge/functional references rather than assuming public availability grants reuse rights.
- [ ] Any third-party code, image, icon, model, data, binary, font, or other asset actually incorporated into the repository has its original source and license/permission identified.
- [ ] I updated `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` if the change introduces material that will be distributed with AsterMax.
- [ ] The UI/branding uses AsterMax-owned or properly licensed assets and does not deliberately reproduce another vendor's distinctive trade dress.
- [ ] Any significant external reference used for the feature is summarized below or in a linked provenance record.
